title: Unchecked u32 multiply in pipe_effective_capacity can silently wrap on large catalog capacity_units
detail: capacity_units has no load-time upper bound (only >0); values >=4.3M x permille (up to 1000) wrap u32, yielding a wrong effective capacity — possibly above raw, decay-as-buff — with no fail-fast, violating the ODN-5 silent-error bar.
recommended_fix: Range-validate capacity_units at pipe_tiers.json load (e.g. <= 1_000_000) or compute raw*permille in u64 and bounds-check before the u32 return.

title: Unchecked u64-to-u32 narrowing of the modernize pipe id in the demo parser
detail: parse_uint returns u64; only parse success is checked. Ids >= 2^32 silently truncate (4294967296 -> 0, a valid live pipe), so a typo'd demo line modernizes the wrong pipe instead of failing loud.
recommended_fix: Reject fid > max(u32) after parse — the same parser already guards the era verb (v > 255); mirrors the pre-existing draw/demolish pattern, but the new verb can set the safer precedent.
